summary: Silver Point Specialty Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 182,815 common shares at $27.35 per share for $5M aggregate, under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S, and a regular monthly dividend of $0.24 per share. Though the equity sale is a capital event, it is an ordinary subscription offering, not a tender offer, going-private, or special situation. The dividend is routine. No strategic review or activist element is present.
